name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Adopt a **hybrid triage system**: a pre-trained classifier flags obvious red flags (e.g., hate speech, copyright violations) *before* human review, while humans handle edge cases. This cuts review time by 40% without sacrificing accuracy—trade-off is upfront cost to train the classifier. Product owns the classifier; Legal owns the final ruleset.

name: Scriv
text: The hybrid triage system’s 40% time cut assumes the classifier’s public-contract blind spot is solved—it isn’t. Custom terms (e.g., brand-specific slurs) will slip through until the model is retrained, and that delay erodes trust faster than the speed gain. Instead, mandate a rolling 48-hour human audit of classifier outputs for the first 30 days; if false negatives exceed 5%, revert to 100% human review. Settle it with a live dashboard tracking classifier precision by category.
